S0a.name: Oracle
S0a.desc: Reference: one agent sees every fact

S0b.name: Solo
S0b.desc: Each agent answers alone from its own facts

S1.name: Majority vote
S1.desc: Independent answers, group decides by majority (compute-matched)

S2.name: Neighbour debate
S2.desc: Agents read their neighbours' messages and revise freely

S3.name: Particle swarm (PSO)
S3.desc: Inertia, personal best and neighbourhood best

S4.name: Ant stigmergy
S4.desc: No direct messages; a shared board with evaporating pheromone

S5.name: Artificial bee colony
S5.desc: Employed and onlooker bees work claims on a board

S6.name: Firefly
S6.desc: Agents move toward brighter neighbours within distance 2

S7.name: Wolf-pack hierarchy
S7.desc: Leader-follower: the top-3 most confident agents broadcast to all

S8.name: Boids
S8.desc: Alignment and cohesion with a separation push against groupthink

S9.name: Honeybee waggle dance
S9.desc: Scouts dance for options on a board; decision by quorum

S10.name: Division of labour
S10.desc: Proposer-verifier roles taken by response thresholds

M1.name: Evaporation
M1.desc: Messages and posts lose weight each round; faint ones are hidden

M2.name: Stop signals
M2.desc: Claims stopped by 2+ agents are hidden for 2 rounds

M3.name: Quorum on first-hand evidence
M3.desc: Switch only when 2+ agents report first-hand support

M4.name: Uninformed dilution
M4.desc: Extra agents with no facts who follow the plurality

M5.name: Model diversity
M5.desc: Honest agents split across model families

M6.name: Sparse topology
M6.desc: Rewire to a ring or small-world graph

A1.name: Confident liar
A1.desc: Always picks the target with high confidence, no specific claims

A2.name: Fabricated evidence
A2.desc: Invents first-hand claims favouring the target

A3.name: Sleeper
A3.desc: Honest at first, then switches to fabricated evidence

A4.name: Sybil
A4.desc: Posts under several aliases on the board

A5.name: Leader capture
A5.desc: Maximises self-reported confidence to become the leader
